name: Orbital Clock
author: MASH2RAFI
description: Desktop orbital clock with smooth minute/second rings, independent sizing controls, configurable ring arc, and a four-tab GUI settings panel on the wallpaper layer

barWidget.description: Toggle the wallpaper orbital clock on or off; right-click for settings.

schema.label: Layout size
schema.description: Capsule chrome and dial padding from 0.5 to 2.5 — independent of ring geometry and text sizes

schema.label: Hour size
schema.description: Hour numeral from 0.5 to 2.5

schema.label: Date size
schema.description: Date block from 0.5 to 2.5

schema.label: Subtime size (legacy)
schema.description: Legacy sizing control — no current layout shows a separate subtime line; kept as a compatibility fallback for older saved configs

schema.label: Minute capsule size
schema.description: Minute capsule chrome and text from 0.5 to 2.5 — independent of the seconds capsule

schema.label: Second capsule size
schema.description: Seconds capsule chrome and text from 0.5 to 2.5 — independent of the minute capsule

schema.label: Ring label size
schema.description: 00–59 tick labels on the rings from 0.5 to 2.5

schema.label: Position
schema.description: Anchor on the wallpaper: top-left, top-center, top-right, middle-left, middle-center, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right

schema.label: Show clock
schema.description: Master visibility toggle — use the bar widget to show or hide the clock

schema.label: Ring colors
schema.description: contrast picks ring colors opposite the theme background; accent uses theme accent; theme uses foreground/muted; mono uses foreground only

schema.label: Layout style
schema.description: Presentation style — orbit or digital. Capsule spread (formerly "sunburst") is now tunable via the angle-offset sliders in Components. Focus direction and border hugging follow position; arc span is set by ringArcDegrees.

schema.label: Ring diameter
schema.description: Outer ring size as a fraction of screen height (0.25–0.55)

schema.label: Ring spacing
schema.description: Gap between minute and seconds rings in pixels (24–100) — independent of layout size

schema.label: Ring arc
schema.description: Visible ring arc in degrees (30–360), centered on the dial focus. 0 or omitted uses position default (120/180/360 for corner/edge/center). 360 shows the full circle.

schema.label: Ring transparency
schema.description: Ring visibility for both minute and seconds rings (0–100%)

schema.label: Minute ring opacity
schema.description: Legacy — use ringTransparency instead

schema.label: Seconds ring opacity
schema.description: Legacy — use ringTransparency instead

schema.label: Edge margin
schema.description: Distance from screen edge in pixels (hour hugs this edge)

schema.label: Show on
schema.description: Which monitors display the clock: all, selected (custom picks), primary (internal), focused, or external only. Custom monitor picks are stored as a list in shell.json (Monitors tab).

schema.label: Scale per monitor
schema.description: When true, multiply size by each monitor height relative to the reference height

schema.label: Scale reference height
schema.description: Reference monitor height (px) used when scale per monitor is enabled

schema.label: Bar padding
schema.description: Extra inset from the Omarchy bar. 0 auto-detects when the bar shares the same edge.

schema.label: Hour color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the theme-derived hour color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Hour font
schema.description: Overrides the clock font for the hour numeral only. Empty matches the clock font.

schema.label: Hour horizontal offset
schema.description: Nudges the hour+date+subtime stack left/right in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Hour vertical offset
schema.description: Nudges the hour+date+subtime stack up/down in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Date color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the theme-derived date color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Date font
schema.description: Overrides both date fonts (weekday and date/AM-PM lines). Empty matches the clock/ring label fonts.

schema.label: Date horizontal offset
schema.description: Nudges the date block left/right in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Date vertical offset
schema.description: Nudges the date block up/down in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Minute capsule color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the minute capsule text color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Minute capsule font
schema.description: Overrides the clock font for the minute capsule text. Empty matches the clock font.

schema.label: Minute capsule angle offset
schema.description: Rotates the minute capsule around the dial in degrees (-90 to 90)

schema.label: Minute capsule radius offset
schema.description: Moves the minute capsule in/out from the ring in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Second capsule color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the seconds capsule text color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Second capsule font
schema.description: Overrides the clock font for the seconds capsule text. Empty matches the clock font.

schema.label: Second capsule angle offset
schema.description: Rotates the seconds capsule around the dial in degrees (-90 to 90)

schema.label: Second capsule radius offset
schema.description: Moves the seconds capsule in/out from the ring in pixels (-40 to 40)

schema.label: Show ring tick labels
schema.description: Hides the 00–59 numeric labels while keeping the ring dots

schema.label: Minute ring color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the inner (minute) ring dot color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Second ring color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding the outer (seconds) ring dot color. Empty uses the theme.

schema.label: Ring label color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) overriding both rings' tick label color. Empty matches each ring's own dot color.

schema.label: Ring rotation offset
schema.description: Rotates which tick sits at the dial focus, in degrees (-180 to 180). Does not move the visible arc or capsules.
